predictions.P1: Profile direct minus visible record sensitivity >= 0.30.
predictions.P2: Key direct minus visible record sensitivity <= 0.10.
predictions.P3: Record-sensitivity interaction >= 0.20 with exact two-sided sign-test p < 0.05.
predictions.P4: Direct minus filler record sensitivity <= 0.10 in each query form.
predictions.P5: Among wrong visible responses, never_stated plus relabeled_missing >= 75%; provisional automated text coding only, not a gate.
predictions.P6: Mistral has the same positive interaction sign and interaction >= 0.20.

decision_rule.purpose: Practical spending rule, not proof of a mechanism or equivalence.
decision_rule.stop_filler: Either filler harm full-plan lower bound > 0.10 and bootstrap lower endpoint > 0.
decision_rule.stop_query: Both visible harm full-plan lower bounds > 0.10 and both bootstrap lower endpoints > 0.
decision_rule.cross_model: Both complete live models must be eligible on the same design; otherwise no proceed_to_dose. Missing peer -> awaiting_replication. Mock -> simulated_only.
